description: Boundary coverage for the name allow-list selector, focusing on the leading-character-removed comparison that the native suite never exercises. The equality check admits a candidate when a target equals the candidate name with its first character stripped (tolerating a leading path separator) and, symmetrically, when a target equals the candidate's name minus its first character. Also covers multi-name lists, multi-container batches in input order, and the all-mismatch path. Output lists each candidate as its name and whether it was admitted.

container=beta included=true
container=gamma included=false
container=/beta included=true
